servers.label: Ornith 1.5 35B
servers.up: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o BatchMode=yes user@laptop 'sudo systemctl start llama-ornith.service'
servers.down: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o BatchMode=yes user@laptop 'sudo systemctl stop llama-ornith.service'
servers.health: ssh -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o BatchMode=yes user@laptop 'systemctl is-active --quiet llama-ornith.service'

servers.label: North Mini Code
servers.up: ssh user@nas 'cd /path/to/compose && sudo docker compose start north-mini-code'
servers.down: ssh user@nas 'cd /path/to/compose && sudo docker compose stop north-mini-code'
servers.health: ssh user@nas 'sudo docker ps --filter name=north-mini-code --filter status=running -q | grep -q .'

servers.label: Replay Trimmer
servers.up: launchctl bootstrap gui/501 $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.trimmer.plist 2>/dev/null; launchctl kickstart gui/501/com.example.trimmer
